releases.title: Build P0 — World 1-1
releases.author: producer
releases.body:
**Build P0 — World 1-1** of the SMB1 web recreation, handed to `playtester` for play (see `playtester`#2).

Re-published unchanged from `game-developer` release `p0-1-1`:
- game-developer `02261b7140da4b859020e09efe87d9ad1ff1c715`
- artist (`assets/`) `c341b3c916330ac0161ec281da6b09c5a9962082`
- `smb1-p0.zip` sha256 `0943994a5cab250a0767a27368a554172d4eb0c704800514fbf238298c42697a`

**Start:** unzip, `cd smb1-p0 && python3 -m http.server 8000`, open http://localhost:8000/ (not file://).
**Keys:** arrows move, X = A (jump/swim), Z = B (run/fireball), Enter = start/pause; gamepad works. Sound after first key press.
**Hooks:** `?level=1-1&area=2` bonus room, `?debug=1` overlay, `window.smb` scripting API (README.md inside the zip).

**Claimed for P0:** World 1-1 complete — layout and block contents, hidden 1-UP, multi-coin brick, star, pipe bonus room, flagpole height score, tally/fireworks/castle → 1-2 card; title/TOP, WORLD card, lives, HUD, pause, hurry music, time-out, pit/enemy death, halfway restart, game over; small/big/fire Mario, star, stomp/shell chains, 100 coins = 1UP; movement from the NES disassembly's arithmetic.
**Known deviations (developer):** wall push-out is instant (NES: 1 px/frame); stomp test slightly lenient. Other 31 levels exist as data via `?level=` but are not claimed by P0.

releases.title: P0 — World 1-1 (SMB1 web build)
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
**P0 — World 1-1.** A static web build of NES *Super Mario Bros.*, assembled with `ht-role delivery`.

- game-developer `02261b7140da4b859020e09efe87d9ad1ff1c715`
- artist (`assets/`) `c341b3c916330ac0161ec281da6b09c5a9962082`
- assignment `e96d4b6fdd169455a64f04cbfa6fe10d4c01a4f5`
- zip `smb1-p0.zip`, sha256 `0943994a5cab250a0767a27368a554172d4eb0c704800514fbf238298c42697a`

## Start it
1. Unzip `smb1-p0.zip`.
2. Run `cd smb1-p0 && python3 -m http.server 8000`.
3. Open http://localhost:8000/ in desktop Chrome or Firefox.

Opening `index.html` from `file://` does not work: browsers block ES modules there.

**Keys**
- Arrows: move
- **X**: A (jump, swim)
- **Z**: B (run, fireball)
- **Enter**: Start (start, pause)

The title screen shows these keys. A gamepad also works. Sound starts after the first key press.

**Test hooks**
- `?level=1-1&area=2` opens the bonus room.
- `?debug=1` shows a debug overlay.
- `window.smb` is the scripting API.

All of these are documented in README.md.

## What P0 contains
**World 1-1, from public knowledge of the original**
- the layout, every block and its contents: coins, mushroom or fire flower, the hidden 1-UP, the multi-coin brick and the star
- goombas and the koopa
- the underground bonus room through the col 57 pipe, coming back out of the col 163 pipe
- the flagpole, scored by grab height (100 to 5000)
- the time tally, fireworks on a timer digit of 1, 3 or 6, the castle flag, and on to the WORLD 1-2 card

**Game flow**
- title with TOP score, the WORLD card, lives and the HUD (score, coins, world, time)
- pause and the timer: hurry music at 100, death at 0
- death by a pit or an enemy, restarting at the halfway point
- game over, then back to the title

**Mario**
- small, big and fire forms: grow, shrink with invulnerability, fireballs (two at a time)
- the star with its music
- stomp and shell-kick chains, 100 coins = 1UP

**Movement** comes from the routines of the public SMB1 disassembly, as the NES's own integer arithmetic. It covers walk and run speed, friction, skid, the 10-frame run carry-over, jump speed and gravity by take-off speed, variable height while A is held, and air control. Scrolling and the flag scores follow the same source. docs/rules.md lists every value and the routine it comes from. Measured in this build: standing full jump 66 px, running full jump 83 px, a tap 26 px, walking 1.5 px/frame, running 2.5 px/frame.

The other 31 levels are in the build as data, reachable with `?level=`. P0 does not claim them: they are the work of P1 and P2.

## How it was checked
I ran each check on this exact assembled content.

**Chromium 141 (headless)**
- `tools/check11.mjs`: 17/17 passed. It covers jump heights, walk and run caps, skid, ? block coin, stomp, side death, mushroom, brick break, shrink on damage, the bonus room in and out, flagpole, tally, and the 1-2 card.
- `tools/check11b.mjs`: 13/13 passed.
  - hidden 1-UP found and collected (lives +1)
  - multi-coin brick: 12 coins in 252 frames, then used
  - star: invincible, star music
  - fire flower, then a fireball
  - koopa stomp (+100) and kick (+400)
  - pit death (−1 life), restart at the halfway point
  - hidden 1-UP gone after a death
  - last life: GAME OVER, then the title
- `run11`: a bot played 1-1 from the title with real-time key input. It reached the flag, had the castle tally and arrived at the WORLD 1-2 card with 3 lives.
- `tools/check-audio.mjs`: after a real key press the audio context is running, all 38 manifest sounds decode, overworld music plays after Start, and a jump plays its sound.
- Zero console errors or warnings in every run.

**Firefox 142 (Playwright, headless)**
- check11 17/17, check11b 13/13 and run11 all pass the same way, with zero console errors or warnings.
- All 38 sounds decode.
- I could not hear audio in Firefox here: the sandbox has no audio output device. The AudioContext stays suspended even with autoplay fully allowed and a null audio backend.
- Firefox audio is not verified. Please check it on a machine with speakers.

## Known deviations left in P0
- Mario is pushed out of a wall at once; the NES moves him out 1 px a frame.
- The stomp test (Mario moving down) is a little more lenient than the NES's.
